panels.title: Collection · on schedule

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS value FROM dhc.vMonitoringStatus s WHERE s.IsEnabled=1 AND s.MonitoringStatus='COMPLETE' AND s.IsOverdue=0 AND s.Environment IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND s.ServerInstance IN (${instance:sqlstring});

panels.description: Last collection completed and not overdue. Says nothing about health of monitored SQL instance.

panels.title: Collection · needs attention

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS value FROM dhc.vMonitoringStatus s WHERE s.IsEnabled=1 AND (s.MonitoringStatus IN ('FAILED','PARTIAL','RUNNING','NO_DATA') OR s.IsOverdue=1) AND s.Environment IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND s.ServerInstance IN (${instance:sqlstring});

panels.description: Collector FAILED/PARTIAL/RUNNING/NO_DATA/overdue. Independent of SQL health alerts.

panels.title: SQL health · CRITICAL instances

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS value FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN latest.RunId IS NULL THEN 'NO_DATA' WHEN s.IsOverdue=1 THEN 'STALE' WHEN ISNULL(alerts.CriticalCount,0)>0 THEN 'CRITICAL' WHEN ISNULL(alerts.WarningCount,0)>0 THEN 'WARNING' ELSE 'OK' END AS Health FROM dhc.vMonitoringStatus s
OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP(1) r.RunId, r.StartedUTC FROM dhc.Run r WHERE r.ServerInstance=s.ServerInstance AND r.Status IN ('COMPLETE','PARTIAL') ORDER BY r.StartedUTC DESC,r.RunId DESC) AS latest
OUTER APPLY (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.Severity='CRITICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CriticalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.Severity='WARNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS WarningCount FROM dhc.Alert a WHERE a.RunId=latest.RunId) AS alerts
WHERE s.IsEnabled=1 AND s.Environment IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND s.ServerInstance IN (${instance:sqlstring})) h WHERE h.Health='CRITICAL';

panels.description: Count of instances with CRITICAL alerts in latest COMPLETE/PARTIAL diagnostic snapshot, excluding overdue snapshots. Not the number of alerts.

panels.title: SQL health · WARNING instances

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS value FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN latest.RunId IS NULL THEN 'NO_DATA' WHEN s.IsOverdue=1 THEN 'STALE' WHEN ISNULL(alerts.CriticalCount,0)>0 THEN 'CRITICAL' WHEN ISNULL(alerts.WarningCount,0)>0 THEN 'WARNING' ELSE 'OK' END AS Health FROM dhc.vMonitoringStatus s
OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP(1) r.RunId, r.StartedUTC FROM dhc.Run r WHERE r.ServerInstance=s.ServerInstance AND r.Status IN ('COMPLETE','PARTIAL') ORDER BY r.StartedUTC DESC,r.RunId DESC) AS latest
OUTER APPLY (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.Severity='CRITICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CriticalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.Severity='WARNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS WarningCount FROM dhc.Alert a WHERE a.RunId=latest.RunId) AS alerts
WHERE s.IsEnabled=1 AND s.Environment IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND s.ServerInstance IN (${instance:sqlstring})) h WHERE h.Health='WARNING';

panels.description: Instances with WARNING alerts but no CRITICAL alerts in the latest fresh diagnostic snapshot.

panels.title: SQL health · STALE / NO DATA

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS value FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN latest.RunId IS NULL THEN 'NO_DATA' WHEN s.IsOverdue=1 THEN 'STALE' WHEN ISNULL(alerts.CriticalCount,0)>0 THEN 'CRITICAL' WHEN ISNULL(alerts.WarningCount,0)>0 THEN 'WARNING' ELSE 'OK' END AS Health FROM dhc.vMonitoringStatus s
OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP(1) r.RunId, r.StartedUTC FROM dhc.Run r WHERE r.ServerInstance=s.ServerInstance AND r.Status IN ('COMPLETE','PARTIAL') ORDER BY r.StartedUTC DESC,r.RunId DESC) AS latest
OUTER APPLY (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.Severity='CRITICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CriticalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.Severity='WARNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS WarningCount FROM dhc.Alert a WHERE a.RunId=latest.RunId) AS alerts
WHERE s.IsEnabled=1 AND s.Environment IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND s.ServerInstance IN (${instance:sqlstring})) h WHERE h.Health IN ('STALE','NO_DATA');

panels.description: Instances with no completed/partial diagnostic snapshot or whose last collection attempt is overdue.

panels.title: Instances · current status

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.ServerInstance AS [Instance],s.Environment,s.MonitorGroup AS [Monitor group],
s.MonitoringStatus AS [Collection],CASE WHEN s.IsOverdue=1 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS [Overdue],
CASE WHEN latest.RunId IS NULL THEN 'NO_DATA' WHEN s.IsOverdue=1 THEN 'STALE' WHEN ISNULL(alerts.CriticalCount,0)>0 THEN 'CRITICAL' WHEN ISNULL(alerts.WarningCount,0)>0 THEN 'WARNING' ELSE 'OK' END AS [SQL health],
ISNULL(alerts.CriticalCount,0) AS [Critical alerts],ISNULL(alerts.WarningCount,0) AS [Warning alerts],
s.IntervalMinutes AS [Interval min],s.LastAttemptUTC AS [Last attempt UTC],
s.LastCompleteUTC AS [Last complete UTC],s.MinutesSinceAttempt AS [Minutes since attempt],
s.LastRowsStored AS [Rows stored],LEFT(s.LastErrorText,280) AS [Last error]
FROM dhc.vMonitoringStatus s
OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP(1) r.RunId, r.StartedUTC FROM dhc.Run r WHERE r.ServerInstance=s.ServerInstance AND r.Status IN ('COMPLETE','PARTIAL') ORDER BY r.StartedUTC DESC,r.RunId DESC) AS latest
OUTER APPLY (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.Severity='CRITICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CriticalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.Severity='WARNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS WarningCount FROM dhc.Alert a WHERE a.RunId=latest.RunId) AS alerts
WHERE s.IsEnabled=1 AND s.Environment IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND s.ServerInstance IN (${instance:sqlstring})
ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.MonitoringStatus='FAILED' THEN 0 WHEN s.IsOverdue=1 THEN 1 WHEN s.MonitoringStatus='PARTIAL' THEN 2 WHEN s.MonitoringStatus='RUNNING' THEN 3 WHEN s.MonitoringStatus='NO_DATA' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END,
CASE WHEN ISNULL(alerts.CriticalCount,0)>0 THEN 0 WHEN ISNULL(alerts.WarningCount,0)>0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,s.ServerInstance;

panels.description: Collection reports delivery status. SQL health summarizes the last COMPLETE/PARTIAL measurement, but becomes STALE when collection is overdue. Counts are for the last diagnostic snapshot, not real-time. Select instance name to open detail dashboard.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT s.ServerInstance,s.Environment,(SELECT TOP(1) r.RunId FROM dhc.Run r WHERE r.ServerInstance=s.ServerInstance AND r.Status IN ('COMPLETE','PARTIAL') ORDER BY r.StartedUTC DESC,r.RunId DESC) AS RunId FROM dhc.MonitoredServer s WHERE s.IsEnabled=1 AND s.Environment IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND s.ServerInstance IN (${instance:sqlstring})) SELECT l.ServerInstance AS [Instance],a.Severity,a.Area,a.ObjectName AS [Object],LEFT(a.Details,350) AS [Details] FROM latest l JOIN dhc.Alert a ON a.RunId=l.RunId ORDER BY CASE a.Severity WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 0 WHEN 'WARNING' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,l.ServerInstance,a.Area;

SELECT CAST(DATEADD(HOUR,DATEDIFF(HOUR,0,e.StartedUTC),0) AS datetime) AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN e.Status='COMPLETE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Complete],SUM(CASE WHEN e.Status='FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Failed],SUM(CASE WHEN e.Status='PARTIAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Partial] FROM dhc.ExecutionLog e LEFT JOIN dhc.MonitoredServer s ON s.ServerInstance=e.ServerInstance WHERE $__timeFilter(e.StartedUTC) AND s.Environment IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND e.ServerInstance IN (${instance:sqlstring}) GROUP BY DATEADD(HOUR,DATEDIFF(HOUR,0,e.StartedUTC),0) ORDER BY time;

SELECT TOP(300) e.StartedUTC AS [Started UTC],e.ServerInstance AS [Instance],s.Environment,e.Status AS [Result],e.RowsStored AS [Rows],DATEDIFF_BIG(MILLISECOND,e.StartedUTC,e.FinishedUTC) AS [Duration ms],CONVERT(varchar(36),e.RunId) AS [Run ID],LEFT(e.ErrorText,350) AS [Error] FROM dhc.ExecutionLog e LEFT JOIN dhc.MonitoredServer s ON s.ServerInstance=e.ServerInstance WHERE $__timeFilter(e.StartedUTC) AND s.Environment IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND e.ServerInstance IN (${instance:sqlstring}) ORDER BY e.StartedUTC DESC,e.ExecutionId DESC;

SELECT TOP(300) r.StartedUTC AS [Time UTC],r.ServerInstance AS [Instance],s.Environment,a.Severity,a.Area,a.ObjectName AS [Object],LEFT(a.Details,350) AS [Details] FROM dhc.Alert a JOIN dhc.Run r ON r.RunId=a.RunId LEFT JOIN dhc.MonitoredServer s ON s.ServerInstance=r.ServerInstance WHERE $__timeFilter(r.StartedUTC) AND s.Environment IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND r.ServerInstance IN (${instance:sqlstring}) ORDER BY r.StartedUTC DESC,a.AlertId DESC;

description: DHC Portal MVP-02: collection state is separate from health of last available SQL Server diagnostic snapshot. SQL health may become STALE when due.
